import itertools
def cellfeats(inp,line,outs):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    hl=[r for r in range(H) if all(v==line for v in inp[r])]
    vl=[c for c in range(W) if all(inp[r][c]==line for r in range(H))]
    def segs(n,lines):

        return s

            cnt=len(pos)
            def ncnt(di,dj):
                a,b=i+di,j+dj
                if not(0<=a<len(rs) and 0<=b<len(cs)): return -1
                R,C=rs[a],cs[b]
                return sum(1 for r,c in six if R[0]<=r<R[1] and C[0]<=c<C[1])

lib='''def line_splits(grid, line):
    """Segment bounds between full one-color gridlines: (row_bounds, col_bounds), each a list of (start, end) excluding the line rows/cols."""
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    hl = [r for r in range(H) if all(v == line for v in grid[r])]
    vl = [c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c] == line for r in range(H))]
    def segs(n, lines):
        out, p = [], 0
        for L in lines + [n]:
            if L > p:
                out.append((p, L))
            p = L + 1
        return out
    return segs(H, hl), segs(W, vl)

def cell_regions(grid, line):
    """The subgrid cells (as (r0,r1,c0,c1)) cut out by the full one-color gridlines of color line."""
    rs, cs = line_splits(grid, line)
    return [(r0, r1, c0, c1) for r0, r1 in rs for c0, c1 in cs]

def count_cells(grid, line, color):
    """Per gridline cell, the number of cells of the given color; one entry per cell in row-major order."""
    return [sum(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            for r0, r1, c0, c1 in cell_regions(grid, line)]

def mark_cells(grid, line, color, marker, threshold=2, bg=None):
    """Gridline cells collapsed to one output cell each: marker where the cell holds at least threshold cells of color, else the background color."""
    rs, cs = line_splits(grid, line)
    bg = bg if bg is not None else max({v for row in grid for v in row} - {line, color}, key=lambda b: sum(row.count(b) for row in grid))
    counts = count_cells(grid, line, color)
    return [[marker if counts[i * len(cs) + j] >= threshold else bg for j in range(len(cs))] for i in range(len(rs))]
